extensions.value: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended encorafenib plus binimetinib as first-line treatment for BRAF V600E mutation-positive advanced non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) in adults. Encorafenib and binimetinib are recommended within their marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangements available to the NHS.
